subcategories.label: No Major Glitches
subcategories.rule:
The use of major glitches is prohibited.
The following things are considered major glitches:
- Zips
- Rewind Tricks
- Drop Glitches
- Slowmo Boost
- Manipulating Gravity with Slowmo
- Rewind Wallrun Extensions
- Quicksand Glitch
- A.I. Glitch (frozen enemies)
- Menu Glitch
- Canceling a wallrun by pausing
- Loadtrigger Manipulation
- Ledge Storage (abuse)
- Shutter Storage (abuse)
- Using invisible dagger for 1-hit KO

subcategories.label: Zipless
subcategories.rule: The use of zips is prohibited.
